title: GeoLifeCLEF 2020
description: GeoLifeCLEF 2020 is a benchmark dataset for plant and organism species identification from geographic location context, created for the GeoLifeCLEF 2020 challenge. It pairs geo-located species occurrence records with multi-spectral satellite image patches (RGB, near-infrared, altitude) and environmental rasters covering France and the United States. The dataset supports research in species distribution modeling and location-based species prediction.
